items.q: They had a street parade once with bands, bands that participated in a street parade including Jimmy Lumsford and some other band.

ctx.x: play with him, and his entire trio as part of the rhythm section. But King Cole refused to give up his musician because he had faith in himself. And it was through the recommendation of King Cole, who knew about my ability, that he recommended me to Lionel Hampton.

In fact, another thing that happened during that time. They had a street parade once with bands, bands that participated in a street parade including Jimmy Lumsford and some other band. I think it was a band, it might have been organized by the musician's union, 767. But it was like two bands playing together. And King Cole and I were contracted to write the music for this arrangements for this band, and that's how King Cole and I became close in writing this music and going around jamming at night.
